app.title: Cortex Trainings
app.tagline: Interactive learning units from your Cortex knowledge base
dashboard.empty: No trainings yet. Create your first one.
briefing.title: New training — briefing
briefing.intro: Four inputs determine scope, tone, and production cost. The agent researches your Cortex before writing anything.
briefing.topicHint: What is it about, and what should learners be able to do afterwards?
briefing.audienceHint: e.g. new employees, coaching clients, 10th grade — beginners or advanced?
briefing.materialHint: Script, course concept, policy, bullet points — the agent builds on it instead of reinventing.
briefing.characterRefsHint: Up to 3 images of your own guide character (mascot, figure, product). It will appear across all films and images instead of the generated abstract character.
briefing.styleRefsHint: Up to 3 images that define the aesthetic. All generated films and images follow this look instead of the preset visual style.
refs.title: Reference images
refs.hint: Optional. Character images fix who appears in all media; style images fix how everything looks. Analyzed once on upload, used by the curriculum and every generated film and image.
project.researching: The agent is researching your Cortex and writing the curriculum …
project.dontClose: Keep this tab open. The run is driven by this page — closing or reloading it cancels the run and nothing is saved.
project.abortConfirm: Stop the run? Everything from this run is lost — nothing is saved until the curriculum is written.
project.curriculumEmpty: No curriculum yet. Start the research run.
project.approveHint: Approving the curriculum unlocks production (Part 2), where video generation and similar steps incur comparatively high costs.
project.approved: Curriculum approved. Production (Part 2) is the next milestone.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Check the server logs.
production.title: Production
production.startHint: Starts media production. Video generation and similar steps incur comparatively high costs.
production.pickRef: Pick the guide character reference image — it anchors the look of all videos. Choose the candidate WITHOUT baked-in text.
production.regenerateRef: Neither fits — generate a new pair (~$0.50)
production.confirmVideoHint: Quoted cost for all video shots:
production.resumeHint: Resumes production at the failed step — completed steps are skipped.
production.downloadHint: A single offline-capable HTML file — runs on double-click, shareable via mail/Drive/LMS.
briefing.visualStyleHint: Applies to all AI videos and images. Explainer animations are unaffected.
